Container.Name: tdld
Container.Overview: yt-dlp on a timer: polls three link lists (audio only, channels, playlists) and downloads new videos with yt-dlp and ffmpeg. A small web UI edits the lists, starts single downloads and shows the logs. A hotfolder converts dropped video files to mp3. For YouTube, put exported browser cookies into /config/ytdlpconfig/cookies.txt (see the project README).

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: Web UI for the download lists and logs. No login: don't expose it to the internet.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Lists, yt-dlp configs, cookies.txt, download archives, logs and the download script

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: Downloaded media, in audioonly/, channels/ and playlists/

Config.Name: Hotfolder
Config.Description: Optional: video files dropped into input/ are converted to mp3 in output/

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: 002: new files are writable for the users group, e.g. over SMB

Config.Name: AUTO_UPDATE_YTDLP
Config.Description: true: update yt-dlp once at every container start instead of waiting for a new image
